# Example Auto Care Oy

> Hand car wash and auto care services in Helsinki, Finland. No automatic brushes: every car is washed
> by hand, panel by panel. Hand wash from 20 EUR (passenger car; higher for
> SUV and van). Prices always include labour and materials.

## Facts

- Address: Esimerkkikatu 1, 00100 Helsinki, Finland
- Phone / text: +358 40 000 0000
- Hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 10:00-18:00, closed Sunday
- Serves: Local area and surrounding districts
- Languages: Finnish (primary), Swedish, English
- Booking: online (30-minute slots), by phone, or by text message

## Pages

- [Prices](https://example-client.com/fi/hinnasto/): all 13 services
  across three vehicle classes (passenger car, SUV, van), every price listed
- [Services](https://example-client.com/fi/palvelut/): hand wash,
  interior and exterior cleaning, full valeting, hard wax, engine wash, tyre
  wash, tyre change, polishing, rust repair
- [Tyre storage](https://example-client.com/fi/rengashotelli/):
  seasonal summer/winter tyre storage
- [Book online](https://example-client.com/fi/varaa/): reserve a
  30-minute slot directly, see live availability
- [Contact](https://example-client.com/fi/yhteystiedot/): address,
  hours, phone, map
- [Privacy](https://example-client.com/fi/tietosuoja/) and
  [accessibility](https://example-client.com/fi/saavutettavuus/) policies

Swedish and English versions of every page exist at the same paths under
/sv/ and /en/ instead of /fi/.
